title: Чернобыль: Зона отчуждения
creator: Drama, Horror
summary: Five youths give chase after a man who has stolen 8 million rubles from them. The man reveals on his video blog his intention to travel to Chernobyl. With every kilometer the journey of the heroes becomes more dangerous and confusing.
